messages:
Alex: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing idempotent handoffs via monotonic ownership_id + short cooldown window. Goals: avoid flapping on hot prefixes, make prefetch safe, and provide a clear client error for routing. Sketch below.

Chen: Nice. How do we keep prefetches from contaminating a new owner's cache?

Alex: Prefetch tasks include expected_ownership_id. On completion they verify lease ownership; if mismatch they drop results and enqueue a read-repair job. No silent commits across ownerships.

Priya: What about client-visible behavior when reclaim attempts happen during cooldown? We should return a structured error so routers can act. Propose: PREFIX_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT {current_ownership_id, cooldown_ms_remaining, proxy_allowed}.

Chen: Proxying helps p99 but is dangerous under load. Add a per-prefix proxy circuit with CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN. When OPEN we return conflict immediately. Circuit trips on proxied_error_rate or proxy_latency spike.

Alex: Implementation sketch: single-row CAS on lease record to swap ownership_id. On success write cooldown_until and append to a bounded audit_tail. CAS retries should use expo backoff starting at 2ms up to 32ms, max 6 attempts to avoid thundering.

Priya: Compaction note: tombstones must be tagged with ownership_id. Compactor must not GC tombstones whose tombstone_ownership_id >= min_live_ownership_id_for_prefix. We publish min_live_ownership_id via heartbeats so compactor is safe.

Chen: We also need metrics & errors: prefix.ownership.conflicts, prefix.proxy.circuit_open_total, prefix.prefetch.drops, and error shape documented for routers. Include cooldown_remaining so router jitter/backoff logic can be smarter.

Alex: Testing plan: run chaos job with 3 nodes, hotkey at 1k QPS, flip ownerships aggressively, measure mismatch rate, proxied_count, p50/p99 latency. Add a clock-skew test but rely on monotonic ownership_id not timestamps for correctness.

Priya: Edge-case: long-lived cursors should prevent demote unless forced by global memory-override. Add active_cursor_count to lease metadata and bump pin_score to avoid demote while >0.

ops-bot: Logged metric proposals: prefix.ownership.conflicts, prefix.proxy.circuit_open, prefix.prefetch.dropped. Reference: https://internal/metrics/prefix-handoff.

Alex: Action items: (1) I'll spike claim CAS + prefetch-drop logic, (2) Chen will draft proxy circuit and error contract, (3) Priya will add tombstone tagging & compactor gating. Will report results in channel in 48h.
